text: huh i just dont see it then what is the name of the button [Image #9]
resolution: The symmetrize feature already existed (the keep +Z / keep −Z buttons + live symmetry badge from req_1190/1191) but was nested inside the non-rig tool block, so it was invisible in rig mode — exactly where the user was (placing wheel joints) when they went looking for it, and easy to miss in the cramped toolbar otherwise. Symmetrize is a whole-mesh operation that does not depend on the selection mode, so moved the whole cluster out of the selMode!=='rig' gate to right after the selection-mode buttons, making it visible in every mode (object/vertex/edge/face/rig/paint), and relabelled the leading 'sym' to 'symmetrize' so it is findable by name. Behaviour unchanged: it auto-targets the model's symmetry axis (Z for the car), you click keep +Z or keep −Z to choose the good half and it rebuilds the other as an exact mirror, with the ✓ symmetric / ⚠ N off badge alongside. Full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed 0ceb24286.
